itinerary.labelHtml:
Day by Day

Lisbon, Sintra and five nights by the coast

Arrival and departure frame seven hotel nights. Every busy day has a nearby pool, town or rest option if the family needs to slow down.

spots.splurgeHtml: Splurge Use a direct airport transfer after the overnight flight; this is an ease purchase, not a sightseeing tour.

spots.saveHtml: Save Choose Regaleira as the only paid Sintra anchor and use train plus local bus/taxi.
spots.splurgeHtml: Splurge A prebooked transfer earns its keep only if it removes queues and preserves a calm return.

• Incomum — book only if the menu fits
  • Pizza Hut Sintra Vila — predictable pizza and pasta fallback
  • Pack a simple picnic for outside the grounds; snacks are not allowed inside Regaleira.

  • Lisbon Oceanarium as a weather-proof kid option.

spots.climate: Atlantic roughly 68–72°F in summer. The official beach listings show summer averages of 68–72°F; swimming and boats still depend on flags, wind and swell.
spots.saveHtml: Save Walk the free boardwalk early and skip the boat if conditions or price disappoint.
spots.splurgeHtml: Splurge A small-group boat is worthwhile only after the operator confirms the route that morning.

spots.cost: Old town and beach are free. The Lisbon–Lagos rail trip requires a reserved long-distance segment and commonly a Tunes connection; price the exact 2027 departure in CP before booking.
spots.climate: About 64–80°F air; Atlantic water roughly 68–72°F. Swimming is optional. A pool is the reliable warm-water fallback.
spots.saveHtml: Save Stay walkable to old town and the station, then use local taxis rather than rent a car.
spots.splurgeHtml: Splurge Choose an apartment/hotel with a heated or sun-warmed pool; that upgrade solves the cool-ocean tradeoff.
spots.restoHtml:
• Casa da Gastronomia Italiana — pizza and pasta
  • Pizza Pazza — simple pizza fallback
  • Pingo Doce/Continente groceries cover breakfast and beach picnics.
spots.altboxHtml:
• Pool afternoon if the train runs late.
  • Marina walk if beach wind is up.

spots.cost: The viewpoints are free. Budget local transfer/taxi money instead of a weeklong rental; confirm the pickup plan before committing because Marinha is not a frictionless transit beach.
spots.climate: About 64–80°F air and 68–72°F sea planning range. Keep children well back from cliff edges and make the beach descent optional.
spots.saveHtml: Save Use a pre-priced transfer and make the overlook the guaranteed payoff.
spots.splurgeHtml: Splurge A half-day licensed coast tour can bundle transport and a boat, but only with a clear cancellation policy.
spots.restoHtml:
• Casa da Gastronomia Italiana — reliable Lagos dinner afterward
  • Nah Nah Bah — burgers/fries fallback
  • Pack lunch rather than depend on the beach concession.
spots.altboxHtml:
• Lagos pool + old town for the easiest day.
  • Praia Dona Ana for a closer beach without the long transfer.

/* popup */

How to Keep the Trip Easy

Book the big pieces, then stop adding

The best version of this week protects comfortable connections, two good family stays and plenty of open time in Lagos.

  1. Track the PIT–LIS / FAO–PIT flights · now through winter
  2. Hold refundable lodging in both cities · pool priority in Lagos
  3. Book the CP train after flights · when the 2027 timetable appears
  4. Book Regaleira and one Algarve splurge · 30–60 days out

Keep these promises

protect the easy week

  • Book the international journey on one ticket; avoid a separate-ticket connection.
  • Stay with two bases rather than adding another city or island.
  • Recheck beach flags, boat conditions, timed-entry rules and the train schedule close to departure.

Pacing the Week

Leave room for everyone to enjoy it

Keep the first day gentle, limit Sintra to one main sight and use the extra Lagos time whenever the family needs a slower day.

Lisbon

Two nights with two simple goals

  • The arrival day has no timed ticket.
  • Sintra gets one palace, not a checklist.
  • Pack after Sintra and take the train while everyone still has energy.

Lagos

Five nights create breathing room

  • Ponta boardwalks still work when boats do not.
  • Move the two local pool and beach days wherever the weather needs them.
  • Skip Marinha if the transfer feels like too much effort.

Coast, towns and nature in one week

The trip leans toward Algarve scenery and pool or beach time, but still includes Lisbon neighborhoods, Sintra gardens and relaxed old-town dinners.
